description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TerminationReasonConfigurationDao within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing CRUD operations and search functionalities for termination reasons in the PIM module.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing CRUD and search operations of TerminationReasonConfigurationDao for termination reasons management in HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment before each test, initializes DAO, and populates test data from fixture.

methods.name: testAddTerminationReason
methods.description: Tests adding a new termination reason and verifies it was saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditTerminationReason
methods.description: Tests editing an existing termination reason and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a termination reason by ID.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of termination reasons with filters.

methods.name: testDeleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple termination reasons.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete non-existent records.

methods.name: testIsExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks whether a termination reason name exists, ignoring case and whitespace.

methods.name: testReasonsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of termination reasons currently in use.

methods.name: testGetTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of termination reasons by name with different casings and whitespace handling.
